title: Digital Helsinki information graphic
slide_intent: Combine summary and human examples because abstract digital services become easier to understand when connected to people.
strategic_value: Helsinki can present digital development as a citywide service with concrete personal benefits.
demonstration: This webpage artwork pairs a blue Digitaalinen Helsinki headline and numbered benefits with a yellow lower area of three illustrated people and service boxes, divided by a wave.
practical_value: Compare overview information and person-specific explanations within one graphic.

content_islands.name: City overview
content_islands.spec: Place the title, prominent number and four icon-supported benefits in the blue upper field.

content_islands.name: Personal examples
content_islands.spec: Follow the wave boundary with three illustrated people and white service boxes on yellow; retain the caption.

reference_purposes.Expression: The graphic combines the blue/yellow palette, wave division, icons and illustrated characters.
reference_purposes.Application: The caption identifies the joint use of several icon types and illustrations in an information graphic.
